meta.title: Tables Turn
meta.description: While feeling around in the dark, you finally glimpse the light.

units.rawText: Magrasea, in the Helios Sector
units.displayText: Magrasea, in the Helios Sector

spans.text: Magrasea, in the Helios Sector

units.rawText: The Arche Pyr burns brightly, dispersing operands through the Helios Sector.
units.displayText: The Arche Pyr burns brightly, dispersing operands through the Helios Sector.

spans.text: The Arche Pyr burns brightly, dispersing operands through the Helios Sector.

units.rawText: (Pants heavily)
units.displayText: Pants heavily

spans.text: Pants heavily

units.rawText: And on the outskirts of the Sector, a rifle-wielding agent faces off against a Daemon in red.
units.displayText: And on the outskirts of the Sector, a rifle-wielding agent faces off against a Daemon in red.

spans.text: And on the outskirts of the Sector, a rifle-wielding agent faces off against a Daemon in red.

units.rawText: Olivia!
units.displayText: Olivia!

spans.text: Olivia!

units.rawText: Casualty report.
units.displayText: Casualty report.

spans.text: Casualty report.

units.rawText: Our grenade launcher squads have... Have taken losses in excess of 25%. A third of our artillery emplacements are offline and are being rebooted.
units.displayText: Our grenade launcher squads have... Have taken losses in excess of 25%. A third of our artillery emplacements are offline and are being rebooted.

spans.text: Our grenade launcher squads have... Have taken losses in excess of 25%. A third of our artillery emplacements are offline and are being rebooted.

units.rawText: Helios' mini-robots have sustained 5% casualties, 15 people from Cyclopes have been heavily injured... Nameless' wounds in particular are quite severe.
units.displayText: Helios' mini-robots have sustained 5% casualties, 15 people from Cyclopes have been heavily injured... Nameless' wounds in particular are quite severe.

spans.text: Helios' mini-robots have sustained 5% casualties, 15 people from Cyclopes have been heavily injured... Nameless' wounds in particular are quite severe.

units.rawText: Monitor104, take over command in Nameless' and my place.
units.displayText: Monitor104, take over command in Nameless' and my place.

spans.text: Monitor104, take over command in Nameless' and my place.

units.rawText: Firewood, get all the cannons back online ASAP, we don't have much time left.
units.displayText: Firewood, get all the cannons back online ASAP, we don't have much time left.

spans.text: Firewood, get all the cannons back online ASAP, we don't have much time left.

units.rawText: Olivia hangs up, then checks her ammo before shifting her focus to the High Order Entropic in front of her.
units.displayText: Olivia hangs up, then checks her ammo before shifting her focus to the High Order Entropic in front of her.

spans.text: Olivia hangs up, then checks her ammo before shifting her focus to the High Order Entropic in front of her.

units.rawText: Her opponent has already healed her gunshot wounds with the operands she stole and the crimson High Order Entropic is still marching toward the Sector's Admin Center in the face of a literal hail of bullets.
units.displayText: Her opponent has already healed her gunshot wounds with the operands she stole and the crimson High Order Entropic is still marching toward the Sector's Admin Center in the face of a literal hail of bullets.

spans.text: Her opponent has already healed her gunshot wounds with the operands she stole and the crimson High Order Entropic is still marching toward the Sector's Admin Center in the face of a literal hail of bullets.

units.rawText: Gahahaha, those Low Order trash are gone and even my power's not coming at my command.
units.displayText: Gahahaha, those Low Order trash are gone and even my power's not coming at my command.

spans.text: Gahahaha, those Low Order trash are gone and even my power's not coming at my command.

units.rawText: But there's tons of operands here just ripe for the taking! It's as though it's drawing me in!
units.displayText: But there's tons of operands here just ripe for the taking! It's as though it's drawing me in!

spans.text: But there's tons of operands here just ripe for the taking! It's as though it's drawing me in!

units.rawText: Churning red operands surge throughout the Helios Sector, boiling in response to the red High Order Entropic's excitement.
units.displayText: Churning red operands surge throughout the Helios Sector, boiling in response to the red High Order Entropic's excitement.

spans.text: Churning red operands surge throughout the Helios Sector, boiling in response to the red High Order Entropic's excitement.

units.rawText: Countless agents are torn to pieces as they scream, Entropized into meals which deliver themselves to this motionless monster.
units.displayText: Countless agents are torn to pieces as they scream, Entropized into meals which deliver themselves to this motionless monster.

spans.text: Countless agents are torn to pieces as they scream, Entropized into meals which deliver themselves to this motionless monster.

units.rawText: But before she can help herself to this plundered power, a string of bullets crashes against her carapace.
units.displayText: But before she can help herself to this plundered power, a string of bullets crashes against her carapace.

spans.text: But before she can help herself to this plundered power, a string of bullets crashes against her carapace.

units.rawText: <size=40>Ahhhhh! I hate hate HATE it when people interrupt my meals!</size>
units.displayText: Ahhhhh! I hate hate HATE it when people interrupt my meals!

spans.text: Ahhhhh! I hate hate HATE it when people interrupt my meals!

units.rawText: ...Fall back, now!
units.displayText: ...Fall back, now!

spans.text: ...Fall back, now!

units.rawText: Just as she gives the order, a sharp blade cleaves the cover she was sheltering behind in two. She ducks from the slash and stumbles to the ground.
units.displayText: Just as she gives the order, a sharp blade cleaves the cover she was sheltering behind in two. She ducks from the slash and stumbles to the ground.

spans.text: Just as she gives the order, a sharp blade cleaves the cover she was sheltering behind in two. She ducks from the slash and stumbles to the ground.

units.rawText: Ahahahahaha! That's not enough to stop me! Hurry up and get Entropized along with this sector and become our allies!
units.displayText: Ahahahahaha! That's not enough to stop me! Hurry up and get Entropized along with this sector and become our allies!

spans.text: Ahahahahaha! That's not enough to stop me! Hurry up and get Entropized along with this sector and become our allies!

units.rawText: Caina raises her sword again, an insane look on her face as she prepares to execute the white-haired girl.
units.displayText: Caina raises her sword again, an insane look on her face as she prepares to execute the white-haired girl.

spans.text: Caina raises her sword again, an insane look on her face as she prepares to execute the white-haired girl.

units.rawText: Dammit, is this the end...
units.displayText: Dammit, is this the end...

spans.text: Dammit, is this the end...

units.rawText: Clang!
units.displayText: Clang!

spans.text: Clang!

units.rawText: No, it's only just begun.
units.displayText: No, it's only just begun.

spans.text: No, it's only just begun.

units.rawText: A shield blocks the descending blade, and a honed body strides through the flames as it arrives by the girl's side.
units.displayText: A shield blocks the descending blade, and a honed body strides through the flames as it arrives by the girl's side.

spans.text: A shield blocks the descending blade, and a honed body strides through the flames as it arrives by the girl's side.

units.rawText: Kept you waiting, huh, Olivia?
units.displayText: Kept you waiting, huh, Olivia?

spans.text: Kept you waiting, huh, Olivia?

units.rawText: The Entropic hordes from just now have all retreated. Cyclopes is safe now; the only threat is this savage beast here.
units.displayText: The Entropic hordes from just now have all retreated. Cyclopes is safe now; the only threat is this savage beast here.

spans.text: The Entropic hordes from just now have all retreated. Cyclopes is safe now; the only threat is this savage beast here.

units.rawText: Ah? Who are you calling a savage...
units.displayText: Ah? Who are you calling a savage...

spans.text: Ah? Who are you calling a savage...

units.rawText: <size=40>Who else could it be but you, you dork?!</size>
units.displayText: Who else could it be but you, you dork?!

spans.text: Who else could it be but you, you dork?!

units.rawText: Kaboom—
units.displayText: Kaboom—

spans.text: Kaboom—

units.rawText: A series of explosions makes Caina flinch out of her gathering rage. She tries to destroy the explosive charges within reach with her sword, but the moment she raises her head, she is hit in the face by a flying kick from above.
units.displayText: A series of explosions makes Caina flinch out of her gathering rage. She tries to destroy the explosive charges within reach with her sword, but the moment she raises her head, she is hit in the face by a flying kick from above.

spans.text: A series of explosions makes Caina flinch out of her gathering rage. She tries to destroy the explosive charges within reach with her sword, but the moment she raises her head, she is hit in the face by a flying kick from above.

units.rawText: <size=40>Swift Lupus Crash!</size>
units.displayText: Swift Lupus Crash!

spans.text: Swift Lupus Crash!

units.rawText: <size=60>Gwaaaaarrrrgh you arrogant worms!</size>
units.displayText: Gwaaaaarrrrgh you arrogant worms!

spans.text: Gwaaaaarrrrgh you arrogant worms!

units.rawText: Is it that Professor again? I can't believe they managed to spare the effort to set all this crap up in such a short time.
units.displayText: Is it that Professor again? I can't believe they managed to spare the effort to set all this crap up in such a short time.

spans.text: Is it that Professor again? I can't believe they managed to spare the effort to set all this crap up in such a short time.

units.rawText: The white-haired girl's friends help her to her feet..
units.displayText: The white-haired girl's friends help her to her feet..

spans.text: The white-haired girl's friends help her to her feet..

units.rawText: The Professor didn't give us any battle plans. Everyone is here of their own free will.
units.displayText: The Professor didn't give us any battle plans. Everyone is here of their own free will.

spans.text: The Professor didn't give us any battle plans. Everyone is here of their own free will.

units.rawText: We don't want Magrasea to be Entropized, we don't want to be modified or reset, and we aren't going to let anyone take our future from us.
units.displayText: We don't want Magrasea to be Entropized, we don't want to be modified or reset, and we aren't going to let anyone take our future from us.

spans.text: We don't want Magrasea to be Entropized, we don't want to be modified or reset, and we aren't going to let anyone take our future from us.

units.rawText: If Eosphorus is doing this because he wants to, then we've also got the freedom to choose our own battles.
units.displayText: If Eosphorus is doing this because he wants to, then we've also got the freedom to choose our own battles.

spans.text: If Eosphorus is doing this because he wants to, then we've also got the freedom to choose our own battles.

units.rawText: Ahhh, what is this bullshit, I don't understand a word of it! You can't beat me, so if I Entropize all of you, you'll have to surrender anyway! Ahahahaha!
units.displayText: Ahhh, what is this bullshit, I don't understand a word of it! You can't beat me, so if I Entropize all of you, you'll have to surrender anyway! Ahahahaha!

spans.text: Ahhh, what is this bullshit, I don't understand a word of it! You can't beat me, so if I Entropize all of you, you'll have to surrender anyway! Ahahahaha!

units.rawText: Everyone, spread out! Arty unit, suppress her location, don't give her time to breathe!
units.displayText: Everyone, spread out! Arty unit, suppress her location, don't give her time to breathe!

spans.text: Everyone, spread out! Arty unit, suppress her location, don't give her time to breathe!

units.rawText: Roger that!
units.displayText: Roger that!

spans.text: Roger that!

units.rawText: Upon receiving their orders, everyone disperses, attacking the High Order Entropic in between rounds of cannon fire.
units.displayText: Upon receiving their orders, everyone disperses, attacking the High Order Entropic in between rounds of cannon fire.

spans.text: Upon receiving their orders, everyone disperses, attacking the High Order Entropic in between rounds of cannon fire.

units.rawText: <size=40>AHHHHHH!!! This is pissing me off...</size>
units.displayText: AHHHHHH!!! This is pissing me off...

spans.text: AHHHHHH!!! This is pissing me off...

units.rawText: Every time Caina tries to strike back, she is engulfed by a saturation bombardment, forcing her to put the operands she would have used for healing into keeping her shields up.
units.displayText: Every time Caina tries to strike back, she is engulfed by a saturation bombardment, forcing her to put the operands she would have used for healing into keeping her shields up.

spans.text: Every time Caina tries to strike back, she is engulfed by a saturation bombardment, forcing her to put the operands she would have used for healing into keeping her shields up.

units.rawText: <size=40>AAHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH! I'M SO PISSED!</size>
units.displayText: AAHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH! I'M SO PISSED!

spans.text: AAHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH! I'M SO PISSED!

units.rawText: <size=40>Die, all of you! DIE!</size>
units.displayText: Die, all of you! DIE!

spans.text: Die, all of you! DIE!

units.rawText: Upon seeing that there's no point in healing herself, she abandons her defense and throws all her operands into battle.
units.displayText: Upon seeing that there's no point in healing herself, she abandons her defense and throws all her operands into battle.

spans.text: Upon seeing that there's no point in healing herself, she abandons her defense and throws all her operands into battle.

units.rawText: She swings her blade indiscriminately at everything around herself, trying to destroy everything in sight.
units.displayText: She swings her blade indiscriminately at everything around herself, trying to destroy everything in sight.

spans.text: She swings her blade indiscriminately at everything around herself, trying to destroy everything in sight.

units.rawText: <size=40>Come on come on come on! I'll take you all with me!</size>
units.displayText: Come on come on come on! I'll take you all with me!

spans.text: Come on come on come on! I'll take you all with me!

units.rawText: Magrasea's screwed anyway, so let's send it off with the fight of our lives!
units.displayText: Magrasea's screwed anyway, so let's send it off with the fight of our lives!

spans.text: Magrasea's screwed anyway, so let's send it off with the fight of our lives!

units.rawText: Magrasea's future is in our hands! Neither you nor Eosphorus have the right to take it from us!
units.displayText: Magrasea's future is in our hands! Neither you nor Eosphorus have the right to take it from us!

spans.text: Magrasea's future is in our hands! Neither you nor Eosphorus have the right to take it from us!

units.rawText: All units listen up, cover Olivia and give her an opening!
units.displayText: All units listen up, cover Olivia and give her an opening!

spans.text: All units listen up, cover Olivia and give her an opening!

units.rawText: Python steps up to shelter Olivia, doing his best to deflect Caina's wild flurry of slashes.
units.displayText: Python steps up to shelter Olivia, doing his best to deflect Caina's wild flurry of slashes.

spans.text: Python steps up to shelter Olivia, doing his best to deflect Caina's wild flurry of slashes.

units.rawText: Pfhahahaha! You can keep dreaming! If my sword doesn't work, my foot blades will!
units.displayText: Pfhahahaha! You can keep dreaming! If my sword doesn't work, my foot blades will!

spans.text: Pfhahahaha! You can keep dreaming! If my sword doesn't work, my foot blades will!

units.rawText: As if!
units.displayText: As if!

spans.text: As if!

units.rawText: Clang—
units.displayText: Clang—

spans.text: Clang—

units.rawText: A shield deploys and it does not budge an inch, saving Olivia from an attack that would have otherwise pierced her core.
units.displayText: A shield deploys and it does not budge an inch, saving Olivia from an attack that would have otherwise pierced her core.

spans.text: A shield deploys and it does not budge an inch, saving Olivia from an attack that would have otherwise pierced her core.

units.rawText: Olivia throws aside her empty rifle and draws Tasha's pistol and dagger before plunging the latter into Caina's core.
units.displayText: Olivia throws aside her empty rifle and draws Tasha's pistol and dagger before plunging the latter into Caina's core.

spans.text: Olivia throws aside her empty rifle and draws Tasha's pistol and dagger before plunging the latter into Caina's core.

units.rawText: This is my promise to Tasha and <cmdr>!
units.displayText: This is my promise to Tasha and {교수}!

spans.text: This is my promise to Tasha and

units.rawText: We will live on and see the future that the Professor has in store for us!
units.displayText: We will live on and see the future that the Professor has in store for us!

spans.text: We will live on and see the future that the Professor has in store for us!

units.rawText: Crack—
units.displayText: Crack—

spans.text: Crack—

units.rawText: Caina's core shatters, and she melts into operands along with her sword.
units.displayText: Caina's core shatters, and she melts into operands along with her sword.

spans.text: Caina's core shatters, and she melts into operands along with her sword.

units.rawText: <color=red>Let's... let's have another good fight next time! Hehehehehe...</color>
units.displayText: Let's... let's have another good fight next time! Hehehehehe...

spans.text: Let's... let's have another good fight next time! Hehehehehe...

units.rawText: <cmdr> and I will stop you, no matter how many times it takes.
units.displayText: {교수} and I will stop you, no matter how many times it takes.

spans.text: and I will stop you, no matter how many times it takes.

units.rawText: The girl holds her dagger before her chest as she makes a solemn pledge to the glittering operands vanishing into the air.
units.displayText: The girl holds her dagger before her chest as she makes a solemn pledge to the glittering operands vanishing into the air.

spans.text: The girl holds her dagger before her chest as she makes a solemn pledge to the glittering operands vanishing into the air.

units.rawText: Just then, an anonymous message reaches each warrior's terminal. They open and read it.
units.displayText: Just then, an anonymous message reaches each warrior's terminal. They open and read it.

spans.text: Just then, an anonymous message reaches each warrior's terminal. They open and read it.

units.rawText: Their fire-forged coordination allows them to instantly tell who wrote that message. After reading it, they exchange looks and chuckle.
units.displayText: Their fire-forged coordination allows them to instantly tell who wrote that message. After reading it, they exchange looks and chuckle.

spans.text: Their fire-forged coordination allows them to instantly tell who wrote that message. After reading it, they exchange looks and chuckle.

units.rawText: Looks like we still have more fighting ahead of us.
units.displayText: Looks like we still have more fighting ahead of us.

spans.text: Looks like we still have more fighting ahead of us.

units.rawText: Time to head to the next battlefield.
units.displayText: Time to head to the next battlefield.

spans.text: Time to head to the next battlefield.

units.rawText: Yes, in order to light the sparks for the future.
units.displayText: Yes, in order to light the sparks for the future.

spans.text: Yes, in order to light the sparks for the future.

units.rawText: With determined looks in their eyes, they set out to the final frontline.
units.displayText: With determined looks in their eyes, they set out to the final frontline.

spans.text: With determined looks in their eyes, they set out to the final frontline.
